notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
At least 1 basic land under your control.
description:
Activate Earthcraft to tap Emmara, Soul of the Accord and untap a basic land.
Tap the land for mana.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord triggers creating a token creature.
Activate Earthcraft to tap the token creature to untap a basic land.
Tap the land for mana.
Sacrifice the token creature to Ashnod's Altar floating {2}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns to untap Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
Repeat.
